name: Michal
summary: A daughter of King Saul who loved David, became his wife, and once saved his life from her father. Later she despised David for dancing before the LORD, and she had no child to the day of her death.

key_moments.title: Given to David as His Wife
key_moments.description: Saul's daughter Michal loved David, and Saul gave her to him as wife, hoping the Philistines would kill David. David brought the price Saul asked, and Saul saw that the LORD was with him.

key_moments.title: Helps David Escape Through a Window
key_moments.description: When Saul sent men to kill David, Michal let him down through a window. She put an image in his bed with goats' hair at its head to fool the messengers.

key_moments.title: Given Away and Taken Back
key_moments.description: Saul gave Michal to another man, Phalti of Gallim. Later David demanded her back, and her husband followed her weeping until Abner sent him home.

key_moments.title: Mocks David for Dancing
key_moments.description: Michal watched from a window as David leaped and danced before the LORD, and she despised him. She mocked him, and she had no child to the day of her death.
